paragraphs: Avimi bar Pappi spoke to Rabbi Zeira (Ketubbot 43b). Rabbi Zeira questioned him and Rav Nachman bar Yaakov, Jerusalem Talmud, end of Na'arah Shenitpattatah, halakhah 14. (“Immi” there is a scribal error.) Rav Nachman, Ulla, Avimi b.P., and Rabbi Chiyya bar Ammi sat (Ketubbot 53a; Avodah Zarah 63b). See above, Rabbi Abba bar Pappi.
